name: tomato-food-delivery
description: Full-stack MERN food delivery app – customer website, admin panel and REST API

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,admin -c red,green,blue "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix admin
